No candidate was quality-filtered, no candidate was collapsed into another, and no candidate was removed as tool noise. handoffNotes: CONTRACT PATH NORMALISED on all 6 new findings: candidates were submitted with bare paths (e.g. 'script/DeployMocks.s.sol') while every reproducing dev entry in the ledger stores the submodule-prefixed form ('lib/phoenix-phase-2-staging/script/DeployMocks.s.sol'). Left unnormalised, each new finding would have minted a fingerprint that could never reconcile against its own family. Originals preserved in `contractAsSubmitted`.

fingerprintPreview on each new finding was computed as sha256(contract:function:rootCauseClass:entryPoint) and verified to collide with NO existing ledger entry. The convention was validated first by reproducing 57 of 60 existing ledger fingerprints; the 3 that do not reproduce are the known deploy:ratchet-mainnet drift entries and are unrelated to this run.

DEV27-V04.verificationOf was submitted truncated to a 16-char prefix and was expanded to the full 64-char ledger fingerprint, or it would not have matched. This is the only edit made to any verification record.
